walkthrough:
Write the expressions for the perimeters of both sectors:
$$\text{Perimeter}(AOC) = r + r + r\theta = 2r + r\theta$$
$$\text{Angle } \angle COB = \pi - \theta$$
$$\text{Perimeter}(BOC) = r + r + r(\pi - \theta) = 2r + r(\pi - \theta)$$

Equate the two perimeters according to the given condition:
$$\text{Perimeter}(BOC) = 2 \times \text{Perimeter}(AOC)$$
$$2r + \pi r - r\theta = 2(2r + r\theta) = 4r + 2r\theta$$

Divide through by $r$ and solve for $\theta$:
$$2 + \pi - \theta = 4 + 2\theta \implies 3\theta = \pi - 2$$
$$\theta = \frac{\pi - 2}{3} \approx \frac{3.14159 - 2}{3} = \frac{1.14159}{3} \approx 0.3805 \approx 0.38\text{ radians} \quad (\text{to 2 s.f.})$$

ai_rubric.Circular Measure: Finds perimeter expressions for both sectors (B3). Sets up equation $2+\pi-\theta = 4+2\theta$ (M1). Obtains $\theta = 0.38\text{ rad}$ (A1).
